message: Command `cd /tmp; mkdir -p asn1_111h; for f in $(ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl-1.1.1g/crypto/asn1/*.c); do b=$(basename $f); curl -sL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openssl/openssl/OpenSSL_1_1_1h/crypto/asn1/$b" -o asn1_111h/$b 2>/dev/null; done; echo "=== diffs ==="; for f in /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl-1.1.1g/crypto/asn1/*.c; do b=$(basename $f); if [ -f "asn1_111h/$b" ]; then d=$(diff "$f" "asn1_111h/$b"); if [ -n "$d" ]; then echo "=== $b ==="; echo "$d"; fi; fi; done` executed with exit code -1.

message.content: The tasn_dec.c is identical between 1.1.1g and 1.1.1h. So the vulnerability is NOT in tasn_dec.c. Let me diff the entire asn1 directory between 1.1.1g and 1.1.1h to find the actual fix.
